subject: Implementation

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: The .NET SDK (build tooling) isn't pinned; there's no global.json
findings.standard: OWASP Software Supply Chain Security Cheat Sheet — OCS-15
findings.recommendation: Add a root global.json that pins the .NET 10 SDK version, with a narrow rollForward policy such as latestPatch, so every build uses the same, inventoried toolchain.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No NuGet lock file; RestorePackagesWithLockFile isn't enabled and there's no packages.lock.json
findings.standard: OWASP Software Supply Chain Security Cheat Sheet — OCS-12
findings.recommendation: Set <RestorePackagesWithLockFile>true</RestorePackagesWithLockFile> in Directory.Build.props, commit each project's packages.lock.json, and restore with --locked-mode in CI.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No SBOM file, and no SBOM generator is configured in the build
findings.recommendation: Generate a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM in the build (for example with a CycloneDX .NET tool or the Microsoft SBOM tool) and publish it with each release.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No repository nuget.config with <clear/> or package source mapping, so the package feed setup isn't controlled by the repo
findings.standard: OWASP Software Supply Chain Security Cheat Sheet — OCS-13
findings.recommendation: Add a root nuget.config that clears inherited sources, declares only the trusted HTTPS feed(s) with packageSourceMapping, and consider signatureValidationMode=require with trustedSigners.

strengths.subject: Implementation
strengths.title: Central Package Management with exact versions for every package; project files carry no version strings

strengths.subject: Implementation
strengths.title: All projects target the supported .NET 10 LTS line, with Microsoft.AspNetCore and Microsoft.Extensions packages aligned at 10.0.13

strengths.subject: Implementation
